items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: I got a lot of lessons... I got a lot of ideas from real good bass players. Like I told you, this Henry Kimmel. Yeah. He actually showed you the thing rings.

ctx.x: Had anybody, uh, 34 years in there. Had anybody given you any lessons at all, even about playing the bass in New Orleans?
Oh yeah, sure, oh, I got a lot of, a lot of lessons, um, I got a lot of ideas from real good bass players. Like I told you, this Henry Kimmel. Yeah. He actually showed you the thing rings.
He actually showed you the thing rings to read him.
